name: English Reading Helper
description: Select text on any page: Ctrl+D define, Ctrl+Shift+D Korean, Ctrl+E explain, Ctrl+G grammar, Ctrl+L collocations, Ctrl+R simplify, Ctrl+P speak. Ctrl+Shift+K builds a knowledge graph of the page. Save words for spaced-repetition review.

build-graph.description: Build a knowledge graph of the current page
